overall: The AG found the Housing Authority violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating outside a posted meeting through serial communications and polling of members on a letter seeking a member's removal.

allegations.summary: Chair allegedly shared a draft letter seeking a member's removal with three other members, outside a posted meeting, constituting deliberation.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the matters discussed within the letter were within the Authority’s jurisdiction and that the Authority violated the Open Meeting Law when a quorum engaged in serial communications regarding these matters outside of a properly posted meeting.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
Publicly disclose the November 24, 2021 letter, if it has not already done so.
remedy_passage: We order the Authority’s immediate and future compliance with the law’s requirements, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
